next.reason: 1985: integer-1 is the column of the leftmost character position. 2023 §2023:13.18.14.4 GR6 b) 'If LEFT is specified, integer-1 is the leftmost column of the printable item' and §2023:13.18.14.3 SR9 '... neither LEFT, CENTER, nor RIGHT is specified, LEFT is assumed', so every 1985 COLUMN clause means the same. The rule refuses nothing; RIGHT, CENTER and relative columns are refused at 1985 by the format, whose record carries them. GR-13.18.14.4-3 (column-character correspondence) states none of this rule.
